text_block_list.text: The river swells from the heavy rainfall.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As Air Shakur observes, she discusses
the finitude
of stats.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Every river has a capacity—an upper
limit for how
much water it can hold
before the excess
overflows. There's no
way to change the limit
without
changing the river itself, potentially

destroying it as it was.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The same restrictions apply to racers'
growth, and
this year, many will have to
wrestle their
limitations.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
